title: Section realization of the actual internal direct-image lax structure and adjunction unit
statement: Let $\Lambda$ be a commutative condensed ring [sk-def-sfb-condensed-ring], let $f:X\to Y$ be a morphism of schemes, and use the small pro-étale sites small relative to module sheaves [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site]. Put $R_T=p_T^*\Lambda$ [sk-def-sfb-pulled-back-coefficients], and also write $R_T$ for its reconstructed section-ring sheaf. Let $E_T:\operatorname{Mod}_{R_T}(\operatorname{Sh}(T_{\mathrm{proet}},\operatorname{Ab}))\simeq\operatorname{Mod}(R_T)$ be the fixed equivalence [def-weil-pbc-internal-abelian-sheaf-module-equivalence]. Use the specified operations and adjunctions of [def-pd-section-module-operations-data], internal relative tensors [def-sfb-modobj-relative-tensor] and sectionwise sheafified balanced tensors [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product]. Write $L_{\rm int}=f^*_{\rm int}$, $P_{\rm int}=f_{*,\rm int}$, $L=f^*_{\rm sec}$ and $P=f_{*,\rm sec}$, with their specified adjunctions. Use the fixed strong monoidal constraints on $E_X,E_Y$ characterized by identity on pure tensors [lem-pe-internal-section-tensor-comparison]. Let $S=R_X$, $R'=f^{-1}R_Y$, $\alpha_f:R'\to S$ be the coefficient map and $c:R_Y\to f_*S$ its adjunct. Give $P_{\rm int}$ the actual pairing obtained from the sheafification-induced lax abelian direct image, scalar restriction [def-sfb-module-lower-star], and the relative-tensor balancing projection. Then the fixed comparisons $E_XL_{\rm int}\cong LE_Y$ and $E_YP_{\rm int}\cong PE_X$ identify the specified adjunctions, including unit and counit, and the latter comparison preserves tensor pairing and regular unit. The transported adjunction unit is geometric inverse-image insertion followed by $a\mapsto1\otimes a$ into $L(A)=S\otimes_{R'}f^{-1}A$. The transported direct-image tensor map is the sheaf map $P(H)\otimes_{R_Y}P(K)\to P(H\otimes_SK)$ sending every local pure tensor $a\otimes b$ over $V$ to $a\otimes b$ over $V\times_YX$; its unit sends $r$ to $c(r)$. These are equalities of the actual specified structure maps, without assuming evaluation preserves sheaf tensors.

proof.text: The unique normalized internal lax structure of [def-pd-proetale-section-module-functors] sends internal local pure tensors to the same tensors on the base-changed site object. Precompose the claimed balancing-projection equation with the abelian sheaf tensor generators and use the monoidality of the canonical sheaf-to-presheaf pushforward comparison. TensorProduct.induction_on and sheafification tensor hom extensionality prove equality of the underlying maps.

proof.text: The ordinary tensor comparisons in [def-pd-proetale-section-module-functors] have their specified pure-tensor formulas from [lem-pe-internal-section-tensor-comparison]. To test the tensor-comparison square, apply faithfulness of the section-to-abelian-sheaf functor, cancel the epimorphic relative-tensor projection, and test on the local generators of the abelian sheaf tensor. The direct-image comparison fixes every section by [lem-sfb-internal-module-operations-transport]. Naturality of the canonical section pure tensors and the two direct-image normalizations make both composites agree on these generators. The section pushforward formula itself is its normalization.

proof.text: Use [lem-pd-ringed-direct-image-pairing-lax] and uniqueness of the specified pure-tensor normalization to obtain the section direct-image unit formula r maps to c(r). For the internal lax structure apply left-unitality at the regular module to the tensor of 1 and 1. Naturality of internal pure tensors and the pushforward normalization imply its unit sends 1 to 1. Reconstruct its section-module map via the fixed direct-image and regular-unit comparisons; linearity over R_Y then gives r maps to c(r). Since the normalized ordinary unit comparison fixes scalar sections, both unit comparison composites agree on every section. All internal tensor-generator and unitor calculations use the relative-tensor construction, without evaluation preserving tensors.

proof.text: For an arbitrary section module A use naturality of the section adjunction unit along the equivalence counit to transport the unit equation from its inverse image M. Evaluate on a section and use the fact that pushComparison fixes sections. The underlying internal adjunction Hom formula, evaluated at the identity, identifies its unit with geometric insertion followed by the scalar-extension unit extendUnitHom. This is precisely the final displayed formula.
